cancellation.intro: Cancellation requests for custom orders are handled by the payment and fulfillment stage.

beforeProduction.label: Before production or material cutting starts
beforeProduction.title: Cancellation may be requested
beforeProduction.body: You may request cancellation while production and material cutting have not started. A full refund is available only while no custom materials or labor have been committed, subject to order review.

afterProduction.label: After production or material cutting starts
afterProduction.title: Cancellation is restricted
afterProduction.body: Once production or material cutting begins, direct cancellation may be unavailable. If a cancellation is approved, a 15%-20% Custom Handling / Restocking Fee may be deducted for custom materials and labor already committed.

shipped.label: Shipped
shipped.title: Use the standard return process
shipped.body: Direct cancellation is no longer accepted after shipment. Please receive the package first, then follow the regular return process if eligible.

highValue.label: High-value delivery
highValue.title: Signature required for orders of $750 USD or more
highValue.body: Orders totaling $750 USD or more require a direct signature at delivery. The signature requirement is part of our delivery and dispute-protection process.
